segments.en: "Yes. About Emma and Tommaso," Leo says.

segments.en: Kevin stops with the cup in his hand.

segments.en: "I knew too," Kevin says quietly.

segments.en: "Okay, okay," he says. "How did you know?"

segments.it: «Lo so» dice Leo. «Io **ho saputo** tutto a giugno.»
segments.en: "I know," Leo says. "I **found out** everything in June."
"In June?" Kevin asks.

segments.it: «Sì. Ero in giardino» dice Leo. «Vedevo tutto dal muretto.»
segments.en: "Yes. I was in the garden," Leo says. "I could see everything from the little wall."
"You could see everything?"

segments.it: «Sì. Io guardo sempre» dice Leo. «Un detective guarda e sta in **silenzio**.»
segments.en: "Yes. I always watch," Leo says. "A detective watches and stays **silent**."
voice: Un detective guarda e sta in **silenzio**.

segments.en: Kevin laughs again.

segments.en: "I'm writing the new words," Kevin says. "**One more** word for today."

segments.en: "Dad, I need you to **promise** me something," he says.
"I have to promise?" Kevin asks.
"Yes. A real **promise**," Leo says.
Kevin puts down the pen.
"Okay," he says. "Tell me."
Leo comes closer to the table.

segments.en: "In the wall of our house there was a **jar**," he says quietly.

segments.en: "Yes. A tin **jar**," Leo says. "With Grandma Anna's things inside."

segments.it: «Ah, il barattolo della nonna» dice. «La mamma l'ha trovato.»
segments.en: "Ah, Grandma's jar," he says. "Mom found it."

segments.it: «Sì» dice Leo. «Dentro ci sono le lettere.»
segments.en: "Yes," Leo says. "There are letters inside."
"The letters?" Kevin asks.

segments.it: «Sì. Otto lettere» dice Leo. «Io le ho viste.»
segments.en: "Yes. Eight letters," Leo says. "I saw them."
Kevin sits down again.
"Leo, when did you see them?" he asks.
"Wednesday," Leo says. "You were at the bar."

segments.it: «Sì. Ma non sa tutto» dice Leo.
segments.en: "Yes. But she doesn't know everything," Leo says.

"What doesn't she know?" he asks.
Leo smiles and doesn't answer.
"I **promised**," Leo says. "I can't talk."
"Who did you **promise**?"

segments.it: «Alla mamma» dice Leo. «Ma **forse** posso dire una cosa.»
segments.en: "Mom," Leo says. "But **maybe** I can say one thing."
Kevin waits.

segments.it: «Nelle lettere c'è un **mistero**» dice Leo. «C'è una lettera L.»
segments.en: "There's a **mystery** in the letters," Leo says. "There's a letter L."
"A letter L?" Kevin repeats.

segments.it: «Sì. Sempre L» dice Leo. «Otto volte L.»
segments.en: "Yes. Always L," Leo says. "Eight times L."
Kevin doesn't understand.

segments.en: "A **promise** is a **promise**," he says.

segments.en: "Good morning, Mr. Colombo!" Kevin says. "A coffee?"

segments.it: «No, grazie» dice Roberto. «Sono qui per un'altra cosa.»
segments.en: "No, thank you," Roberto says. "I'm here for another thing."
Roberto comes closer to the counter.

segments.it: Mette la **busta** sul banco e la apre piano.
segments.en: He puts the **envelope** on the counter and opens it slowly.

segments.it: «Signor Carter» dice Roberto, molto formale. «**Lei lo sapeva**?»
segments.en: "Mr. Carter," Roberto says, very formal. "**Did you know**?"

segments.it: Kevin smette di asciugare il bicchiere.
segments.en: Kevin stops drying the glass.
voice: Kevin smette di asciugare il bicchiere.

segments.en: "Knew what?" he asks.

segments.en: Roberto takes a **sheet** and looks at it.
voice: Roberto prende un **foglio** e lo guarda.

segments.en: "Emma and Tommaso," he says. "They are a **couple**."
The bar goes quiet.

segments.it: Matteo alza la testa dalla macchina del caffè.
segments.en: Matteo raises his head from the coffee machine.
voice: Matteo alza la testa dalla macchina del caffè.

segments.en: "Ah," Kevin says. "Yes. **I knew**."
Roberto opens his eyes wide.
"**You knew**?" he repeats. "Really?"
"Yes," Kevin says. "Since June."
Roberto puts the **sheet** on the counter.

segments.it: «Io **l'ho saputo** ad agosto» dice. «**Dopo** il taglio della siepe.»
segments.en: "I **found out** in August," he says. "**After** the hedge trimming."
"Ah," Kevin says. "I see."

segments.it: «Ma lei non ha detto niente a sua moglie» dice Roberto.
segments.en: "But you didn't say anything to your wife," Roberto says.
voice: Ma lei non ha detto niente a sua moglie

segments.en: Kevin doesn't answer.
"Is that true?" he asks.

segments.it: «Sì» dice Kevin piano. «È vero. Non ho detto niente.»
segments.en: "Yes," Kevin says quietly. "It's true. I didn't say anything."

segments.en: Matteo laughs behind the counter.
"Kevin, you're a disaster," Matteo says.
"Thanks, Matteo," Kevin says.
Roberto doesn't laugh.

segments.it: «Signor Carter, questa è una cosa **importante**» dice.
segments.en: "Mr. Carter, this is an **important** thing," he says.
voice: Signor Carter, questa è una cosa **importante**

segments.en: "I know," Kevin says.

segments.it: «Io sono il presidente del comitato» continua Roberto. «E un padre.»
segments.en: "I'm the president of the committee," Roberto continues. "And a father."

segments.en: "Yes," Kevin says. "**Of course**."
Roberto adjusts his jacket.

segments.it: «In famiglia, la **fiducia** è tutto» dice. «Senza **fiducia**, non c'è niente.»
segments.en: "In a family, **trust** is everything," he says. "Without **trust**, there's nothing."

segments.it: «Lei ha nascosto una cosa a sua moglie» dice Roberto.
segments.en: "You hid something from your wife," Roberto says.

segments.en: "It's not a **lie**," Kevin says. "It's... a **silence**."

segments.it: «Ah, il **silenzio**» dice Roberto. «Il **silenzio** è come una **bugia**, signor Carter.»
segments.en: "Ah, **silence**," Roberto says. "**Silence** is like a **lie**, Mr. Carter."

segments.en: Roberto turns around quickly.
"A year?" he asks.

segments.it: «Sì. Da prima dell'estate» dice Matteo. «Nessuno mi ha chiesto niente.»
segments.en: "Yes. Since before the summer," Matteo says. "Nobody asked me anything."

segments.it: «Ma questa è una vergogna» dice Roberto.
segments.en: "But this is a disgrace," Roberto says.

segments.it: «No, è un bar» dice Matteo. «Qui tutti sanno tutto.»
segments.en: "No, it's a bar," Matteo says. "Here everybody knows everything."
Roberto looks at Kevin.

segments.it: «Signor Carter, io non voglio **mentire**» dice. «Secondo me, lei sbaglia.»
segments.en: "Mr. Carter, I don't want to **lie**," he says. "In my opinion, you're wrong."
"I think so too," Kevin says.

segments.it: «Bene. Allora possiamo **chiarire** questa cosa» dice Roberto.
segments.en: "Good. Then we can **clear up** this thing," Roberto says.
"How?" Kevin asks.

segments.it: «Con una cena» dice Roberto. «Venga a casa nostra. Con sua moglie.»
segments.en: "With a dinner," Roberto says. "Come to our house. With your wife."

voice: Kevin apre la bocca, poi la chiude.

segments.en: "A dinner?" he repeats.

segments.en: "Okay," Kevin says. "Thank you."

"But there's one condition," he says.
"Which one?"

segments.it: «La siepe» dice Roberto. «La siepe non si tocca.»
segments.en: "The hedge," Roberto says. "The hedge is not touched."
Matteo laughs loudly.
"Always the hedge," Matteo says.
"The hedge is **important**," Roberto says. "Like **trust**."

segments.it: «Va bene» dice Kevin. «La siepe sta ferma.»
segments.en: "Okay," Kevin says. "The hedge stays still."

segments.en: "And this?" Kevin asks.

segments.en: "A **meeting**?" Kevin asks. "For a fifteen-year-old **couple**?"

segments.en: "Leo!" Tommaso says quietly.

segments.en: "Leo is a detective," Kevin says. "He has the notebook of facts."
Roberto looks at Leo with **suspicion**.
"A notebook?" he asks.
"Yes," Leo says. "I **found out** everything from the little wall."
Franco laughs loudly.

segments.it: «Bravo, Leo» dice Franco. «Sei più bravo del comitato.»
segments.en: "Good job, Leo," Franco says. "You're better than the committee."
Roberto doesn't laugh.

segments.it: «Franco, questa non è una barzelletta» dice.
segments.en: "Franco, this isn't a joke," he says.

segments.en: Chiara looks at Franco quickly.
Franco closes his mouth.
Roberto takes the newspaper.

segments.it: «Signora Ferri, signor Carter» dice. «La cena è ancora aperta.»
segments.en: "Mrs. Ferri, Mr. Carter," he says. "The dinner is still open."

segments.it: «La cena a casa nostra» dice Roberto. «Con Marina.»
segments.en: "The dinner at our house," Roberto says. "With Marina."
"Ah, yes," Kevin says. "I understood yesterday."

segments.it: «Bene» dice Roberto. «Ma c'è una **promessa** da fare.»
segments.en: "Good," Roberto says. "But there's a **promise** to make."
"What **promise**?" Chiara asks.
Roberto raises his index finger.

segments.it: «La siepe non si tocca» dice Roberto, per la terza volta.
segments.en: "The hedge is not touched," Roberto says, for the third time.

Kevin raises his hands.

segments.en: "**Of course**, it's not an easy rule," she says. "But it's necessary."
"What is it?" Emma asks.
Chiara takes her coffee.

segments.it: «Alla cena, niente segreti a tavola» dice. «Niente **segreti**.»
segments.en: "At dinner, no secrets at the table," she says. "No **secrets**."

segments.en: "Mom's rule," Kevin says. "Rule number one."

Kevin looks at her.

segments.it: «Anna **conosceva** una persona» dice Chiara. «Una persona che nessuno in famiglia **ha mai conosciuto**.»
segments.en: "Anna **knew** a person," Chiara says. "A person nobody in the family **ever met**."

segments.it: «E forse quella persona è **ancora** qui» dice Chiara.

segments.en: "Yes. But I was little," Chiara says.

segments.it: «Se sai una cosa, dimmela **prima**» dice Chiara. «Non **dopo**.»
segments.en: "If you know something, tell me **first**," Chiara says. "Not **after**."
Kevin nods.

segments.it: «Da oggi in poi» dice. «Te lo **prometto** di nuovo.»
segments.en: "From today on," he says. "I **promise** you again."

segments.it: «E io **mi fido** di te» dice Chiara.
